acceptanceCriteria: For a real change, a reviewer can navigate changed hunk, its explicit evidence citations, governing requirement and recorded verification result at their pinned revisions; each edge names the artifact that justifies it.

No link is inferred from item position, matching text, shared path or UI proximity. Missing, stale, ambiguous, unverified and unsupported edges remain visible gaps; structural linking never claims semantic support or passing tests.

Extend the existing optional loopback console and CLI-produced artifacts without a second provenance store, database, outbound connection or default-core UI; retain all six evidence axes and exact source attribution.

Measure the existing U4 operator-time comparison against the CLI on the same review tasks, recording correctness and missing-link recognition alongside navigation time; preserve failed or unavailable observations.

Cover complete and broken chains, hostile artifact content and browser accessibility/navigation in the accepted matrix. Verify foreground-process cleanup if launch behavior changes; document rollback to existing panes and retain mandatory console/core gates.
body: Owner requested all five n8n-inspired improvements as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. Original Go implementations of the patterns; no n8n source import. Extend the cited existing mechanisms. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Extend docs/specs/local-admin-console-v0.md, internal/console, and existing CEM/OCM/frontier artifacts. Prior art: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n-docs/blob/main/docs/build/work-with-data/reference-data/link-data-items/how-items-link-through-workflows.md.
